plugins.name: design-theory
plugins.description: Design review and UI critique: 16 clusters of design theory as the rationale and review lens for UI, copy, layout, charts, motion and brand, and equally for specs, architecture, code and infra, explained as plain-language consequences.

plugins.name: code-theory
plugins.description: Code review and quality gate: reviews code against eight areas of computer-science principle (tests, reliability, simplicity, maintainability, privacy, security, architecture, design for the context of use). Every finding needs evidence, and each is explained as a plain-language consequence.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Design review of one screen, page, screenshot, URL or UI diff: at most seven findings, worst first, each saying where it is, why it costs the user and the fix.
